Add Checkov, Conftest, and Gitleaks integration
Introduces Checkov, Conftest, and Gitleaks as new detectors in the scanning pipeline. Updates orchestration functions to include these tools, adds configuration files for Checkov, Kube-Linter, and Polaris, and implements HTML vulnerability matrix output. Also improves normalization logic for kube-score findings and removes obsolete test and log files.
